column2: the plan omits `skills/design/references/plan-review.md` from files to modify/create even though it is the normative step 3 source (`skill.md` mandates reading it). after `python/voting.py` and `skills/shared/voting-protocol.md` switch to strict-majority yes scoring, that reference would still tell operators and reviewers that any yes voter rating `blocker` or `major` earns +2. `render_plan_review_main` does not inject competition text from `rendering.py`, so updating `rendering.py` and `voting-protocol.md` alone leaves design-side proposer incentives stale and the shipped prompt surface internally inconsistent for the required prompt/math pair.

the plan treats the committed corpus re-score as optional even though the issue's verification criterion requires re-scoring the committed corpus and observing that the +2 share among accepted findings develops real, stable spread (variance well above ~0). with optional verification, unit tests can pass and the pr can merge without checking whether the intended scoring signal changed at all, leaving the phase ii success criterion unverifiable.
